inputs.description:
Whether to neutralise spreadsheet formulas in the exported CSV.

A cell whose first character is `=`, `+`, `-`, `@`, a tab or a carriage return is a
FORMULA to Excel, LibreOffice and Google Sheets — quoting does not stop it, because the
quotes are removed by CSV parsing before the formula is detected. Exporting a table of
user-submitted values therefore hands whoever wrote those values a way to run a formula
in the reader's spreadsheet, which can read the surrounding cells and send them out
(CWE-1236). Nothing appears wrong at export time; the damage happens in another
application entirely.

When true, such a cell is prefixed with an apostrophe, which every major spreadsheet
reads as "this is text" and does not display. Set it to false only if you are exporting
formulas on purpose AND you control every value in the table.

inputs.description: Target element to attach the overlay, valid values are "body" or a local ng-template variable of another element (note: use binding with brackets for template variables, e.g. [appendTo]="mydiv" for a div element having #mydiv as variable name).

inputs.name: ptTooltip
inputs.description: Used to pass attributes to DOM elements inside the Tooltip component.

inputs.name: pTooltipPT
inputs.description: Used to pass attributes to DOM elements inside the Tooltip component.

inputs.name: pTooltipUnstyled
inputs.description: Indicates whether the component should be rendered without styles.

declarations.name: TreeTable
declarations.description: TreeTable is used to display hierarchical data in tabular format.

inputs.name: columns
inputs.description: An array of objects to represent dynamic columns.

inputs.name: styleClass
inputs.description: Style class of the component.

inputs.name: tableStyle
inputs.description: Inline style of the table.

inputs.name: tableStyleClass
inputs.description: Style class of the table.

inputs.name: autoLayout
inputs.description: Whether the cell widths scale according to their content or not.

inputs.name: lazy
inputs.description: Defines if data is loaded and interacted with in lazy manner.

inputs.name: lazyLoadOnInit
inputs.description: Whether to call lazy loading on initialization.

inputs.name: paginator
inputs.description: When specified as true, enables the pagination.

inputs.name: rows
inputs.description: Number of rows to display per page.

inputs.name: first
inputs.description: Index of the first row to be displayed.

inputs.name: pageLinks
inputs.description: Number of page links to display in paginator.

inputs.name: rowsPerPageOptions
inputs.description: Array of integer/object values to display inside rows per page dropdown of paginator

inputs.name: alwaysShowPaginator
inputs.description: Whether to show it even there is only one page.

inputs.name: paginatorPosition
inputs.description: Position of the paginator.

inputs.name: paginatorStyleClass
inputs.description: Custom style class for paginator

inputs.name: paginatorDropdownAppendTo
inputs.type: HTMLElement | ElementRef | TemplateRef<any> | string | null | undefined | any
inputs.description: Target element to attach the paginator dropdown overlay, valid values are "body" or a local ng-template variable of another element (note: use binding with brackets for template variables, e.g. [appendTo]="mydiv" for a div element having #mydiv as variable name).

inputs.name: currentPageReportTemplate
inputs.description: Template of the current page report element. Available placeholders are {currentPage},{totalPages},{rows},{first},{last} and {totalRecords}

inputs.name: showCurrentPageReport
inputs.description: Whether to display current page report.

inputs.name: showJumpToPageDropdown
inputs.description: Whether to display a dropdown to navigate to any page.

inputs.name: showFirstLastIcon
inputs.description: When enabled, icons are displayed on paginator to go first and last page.

inputs.name: showPageLinks
inputs.description: Whether to show page links.

inputs.name: defaultSortOrder
inputs.description: Sort order to use when an unsorted column gets sorted by user interaction.

inputs.name: sortMode
inputs.description: Defines whether sorting works on single column or on multiple columns.

inputs.name: resetPageOnSort
inputs.description: When true, resets paginator to first page after sorting.

inputs.name: customSort
inputs.description: Whether to use the default sorting or a custom one using sortFunction.

inputs.name: selectionMode
inputs.description: Specifies the selection mode, valid values are "single" and "multiple".

inputs.name: contextMenuSelection
inputs.description: Selected row with a context menu.

inputs.name: contextMenuSelectionMode
inputs.description: Mode of the contet menu selection.

inputs.name: dataKey
inputs.description: A property to uniquely identify a record in data.

inputs.name: metaKeySelection
inputs.description: Defines whether metaKey is should be considered for the selection. On touch enabled devices, metaKeySelection is turned off automatically.

inputs.name: compareSelectionBy
inputs.description: Algorithm to define if a row is selected, valid values are "equals" that compares by reference and "deepEquals" that compares all fields.

inputs.name: rowHover
inputs.description: Adds hover effect to rows without the need for selectionMode.

inputs.name: loading
inputs.description: Displays a loader to indicate data load is in progress.

inputs.name: loadingIcon
inputs.description: The icon to show while indicating data load is in progress.

inputs.name: showLoader
inputs.description: Whether to show the loading mask when loading property is true.

inputs.name: scrollable
inputs.description: When specified, enables horizontal and/or vertical scrolling.

inputs.name: scrollHeight
inputs.description: Height of the scroll viewport in fixed pixels or the "flex" keyword for a dynamic size.

inputs.name: virtualScroll
inputs.description: Whether the data should be loaded on demand during scroll.

inputs.name: virtualScrollItemSize
inputs.description: Height of a row to use in calculations of virtual scrolling.

inputs.name: virtualScrollOptions
inputs.description: Whether to use the scroller feature. The properties of scroller component can be used like an object in it.

inputs.name: virtualScrollDelay
inputs.description: The delay (in milliseconds) before triggering the virtual scroll. This determines the time gap between the user's scroll action and the actual rendering of the next set of items in the virtual scroll.

inputs.name: frozenWidth
inputs.description: Width of the frozen columns container.

inputs.name: frozenColumns
inputs.description: An array of objects to represent dynamic columns that are frozen.

inputs.name: resizableColumns
inputs.description: When enabled, columns can be resized using drag and drop.

inputs.name: columnResizeMode
inputs.description: Defines whether the overall table width should change on column resize, valid values are "fit" and "expand".

inputs.name: reorderableColumns
inputs.description: When enabled, columns can be reordered using drag and drop.

inputs.name: contextMenu
inputs.description: Local ng-template varilable of a ContextMenu.

inputs.name: rowTrackBy
inputs.description: Function to optimize the dom operations by delegating to ngForTrackBy, default algorithm checks for object identity.

inputs.name: filters
inputs.description: An array of FilterMetadata objects to provide external filters.

inputs.name: globalFilterFields
inputs.description: An array of fields as string to use in global filtering.

inputs.name: filterDelay
inputs.description: Delay in milliseconds before filtering the data.

inputs.name: filterMode
inputs.description: Mode for filtering valid values are "lenient" and "strict". Default is lenient.

inputs.name: filterLocale
inputs.description: Locale to use in filtering. The default locale is the host environment's current locale.

inputs.name: paginatorLocale
inputs.description: Locale to be used in paginator formatting.

inputs.name: totalRecords
inputs.description: Number of total records, defaults to length of value when not defined.

inputs.name: sortField
inputs.description: Name of the field to sort data by default.

inputs.name: sortOrder
inputs.description: Order to sort when default sorting is enabled.

inputs.name: multiSortMeta
inputs.description: An array of SortMeta objects to sort the data by default in multiple sort mode.

inputs.name: selection
inputs.description: Selected row in single mode or an array of values in multiple mode.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: An array of objects to display.

inputs.name: virtualRowHeight
inputs.description: Indicates the height of rows to be scrolled.

inputs.name: selectionKeys
inputs.description: A map of keys to control the selection state.

inputs.name: showGridlines
inputs.description: Whether to show grid lines between cells.

outputs.name: selectionChange
outputs.description: Callback to invoke on selected node change.

outputs.name: contextMenuSelectionChange
outputs.description: Callback to invoke on context menu selection change.

outputs.name: onFilter
outputs.description: Callback to invoke when data is filtered.

outputs.name: onNodeExpand
outputs.description: Callback to invoke when a node is expanded.

outputs.name: onNodeCollapse
outputs.description: Callback to invoke when a node is collapsed.

outputs.name: onPage
outputs.description: Callback to invoke when pagination occurs.

outputs.name: onSort
outputs.description: Callback to invoke when a column gets sorted.

outputs.name: onLazyLoad
outputs.description: Callback to invoke when paging, sorting or filtering happens in lazy mode.

outputs.name: sortFunction
outputs.description: An event emitter to invoke on custom sorting, refer to sorting section for details.

outputs.name: onColResize
outputs.description: Callback to invoke when a column is resized.

outputs.name: onColReorder
outputs.description: Callback to invoke when a column is reordered.

outputs.name: onNodeSelect
outputs.description: Callback to invoke when a node is selected.

outputs.name: onNodeUnselect
outputs.description: Callback to invoke when a node is unselected.

outputs.name: onContextMenuSelect
outputs.description: Callback to invoke when a node is selected with right click.

outputs.name: onHeaderCheckboxToggle
outputs.description: Callback to invoke when state of header checkbox changes.

outputs.name: onEditInit
outputs.description: Callback to invoke when a cell switches to edit mode.

outputs.name: onEditComplete
outputs.description: Callback to invoke when cell edit is completed.

outputs.name: onEditCancel
outputs.description: Callback to invoke when cell edit is cancelled with escape key.

outputs.name: selectionKeysChange
outputs.description: Callback to invoke when selectionKeys are changed.
